entries.title: Fixed Longitudinal Hook Jaw Pipe Wrench
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed longitudinal-hook-jaw pipe-wrench appearance. A whole long cast handle joins a thick side spine and two separate-length bored guide regions as one continuous body. A complete long rectangular hook stem passes longitudinally through those real channels and ends in a broad upper hooked jaw with full blunt serrations. One opposed lower heel jaw is rooted on the cast head, leaving a visible open mouth. A whole annular ridged adjustment nut surrounds the stem in the interruption between the guide collars; a shallow complete grip inset finishes the handle. All geometry new, not the earlier transverse sliding flat-jaw adjustable wrench with added teeth or an open C roller cutter recoloured. Three opaque materials, one model zero scenes. Static empty visual tool only: no pipe, sharp tooth specification, helical thread engagement, moving adjustment, jaw travel or gripping action, torque, engineering, manufacture, use instructions or safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Four Eccentric Lobes And Loop Stem Cam
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed four-lobe climbing-cam exterior. Four separately editable short thick asymmetric eccentric plates lie in alternating directions along one common full axle. A complete central neck and continuous long twin-strand loop stem join that head to a true empty attachment loop. An independent wide trigger crossbar and four complete thin fixed links connect to the individual lobe plates. The whole object lies on the finite flat underside of its lowest full plate. Unlike the old two-solid D frame and gate, this whole has an articulated-looking stacked eccentric head and long loop stem, not a closing gate. Unlike the old three-hook puller, there is no radial yoke of long inward hook jaws, pressure spindle or hex screw. All numeric geometry newly authored; no old mesh imported or extracted. One prop zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metre units Z up. Fixed stylized overlaps only, no spring simulation, moving cam, mechanical linkage or real cam curve calculation. No expansion, grip, locking, crack fit, load, climbing, rescue, fall arrest, protective equipment, manufacture, real-world use or safety performance represented. Static decorative game art only; rigging animation and interaction not made.

entries.title: Fixed Cowled Tandem Cockpit And Four Runner Bobsled
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty cowled tandem-seat bobsled exterior. A continuous thick closed-bottom shell joins a broad raised foredeck to a rearward oval cockpit with full inner walls and floor. Two complete low cushions with inclined back pads lie inside the cockpit. Two separate transverse underbody beams carry four independent short upturned blade runners through four complete pedestals; four body mounts join these beams into the shell underside. Unlike the complete wooden sled with five open planks and two continuous long runners, this entire vehicle has a deep integral cockpit and broad closed nose cowling on four short separated blades. Unlike the complete snowmobile, it has no track, straddle saddle, motor hood or ski steering arms. Every coordinate is newly authored with no old mesh extracted or imported. One prop zero scenes, metre units Z up, four opaque constant PBR roles. Empty static decorative game art, no people. Fixed overlaps are visual roots, not working bearings. No sliding, steering, braking, aerodynamics, speed, rider fit, load, ice or snow compatibility, manufacture, operation or safety capability. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
